newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI SEEN STARTING HIGHER, FOCUS ON NOKIA.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI SEEN STARTING HIGHER, FOCUS ON NOKIA.

text.p: Shares were seen opening
higher on Tuesday on the back of Wall Street gains overnight
but the direction would depend on how the market views Nokia's
Q1 earnings report at noon (0900 GMT), brokers said.
"I think the rise in the U.S. will be a boost for us," a
broker said.
Remembering how Nokia's Swedish rival Ericsson was
hammered on its first-quarter report last Friday, brokers said
even a good report by Nokia was no guarantee of a warm reception
from the market.
Brokers said that even after the Nokia report, trade could
remain hesistant ahead of this week's key U.S. economic data,
starting with the employment cost index today at 1230 GMT.
Rautaruukki , which yesterday set its share
offering price at 42.00 markka, would also be in focus, brokers
said.
"There could be some minor pressure if people decide to
sell their shares and buy them back via the offering," one
broker said. Rautaruukki closed at 43.80 markka on Monday.
--Helsinki Newsroom +358-9-680 50 235
